knowledge:
- key_parameters: gene_set=Character vector or data frame column containing the input gene identifiers ;; i_species=Input species (e.g., "h_sapiens", "m_musculus", "r_norvegicus", "d_rerio", "d_melangoaster", "c_elegans") ;; o_species=Output species for ortholog mapping and comparison ;; input_id=Identifier type of the input gene set ("Ensembl_id", "Entrez_id", "Symbol") ;; output_ids=Identifier type for output (must include "Ensembl_id" if using getGEx) ;; map_species=Species to map and compare (must include all species specified in o_species) ;; map_tissues=Tissues to map, retrieved using getTissues() ;; mapping_tool=Tool for ID mapping ("annotationDBI" or "biomaRt") ;; ortholog_database=Database for ortholog mapping ("NCBIOrtho" or "HomoloGene") ;; metric_type=Metric to calculate ("CV_Tissue", "CV_Species", "DS_Gene", "DS_Gene_all", "DS_Tissue", "DS_Tissue_all")
- alternatives: mapping_tool can be set to "annotationDBI" (default) or "biomaRt" ;; ortholog_database can be set to "HomoloGene" (default) or "NCBIOrtho"
- when_to_use: Use when comparing gene expression variability (Coefficient of Variation) and diversity/specificity (Shannon Entropy) of a specific gene set across multiple tissues and/or species using normal wild-type RNA-Seq data.
- pitfalls: Any species planned for comparison must be specified in both map_species AND o_species ;; The getGEx function requires that "Ensembl_id" is included as an output_id ;; Expression values plotted via plotSpeciesGEx are not meant to be compared across species directly; use CV or DS metrics instead.

workflows.name: cross_species_expression_and_variability
workflows.intent: Convert gene identifiers, retrieve Bgee expression data, and calculate/visualize the Coefficient of Variation (CV) across species or tissues.
input: gene_set (character vector of gene symbols or IDs)
map_tissues (character vector of shared tissues, e.g., from getTissues())
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve shared tissues using getTissues ;; 2. Initialize the CoSIAn object with the gene set, species, tissues, and CV metric type ;; 3. Convert gene identifiers using getConversion ;; 4. Retrieve gene expression data using getGEx ;; 5. Plot gene expression across species using plotSpeciesGEx ;; 6. Calculate CV metrics using getGExMetrics ;; 7. Plot CV metrics using plotCVGEx
workflows.code:
CoSIA::getTissues(c("m_musculus", "r_norvegicus"))

CoSIAn_Obj <- CoSIA::CoSIAn(
    gene_set = unique(monogenic_kid_sample$Gene),
    i_species = "h_sapiens",
    o_species = c(
        "h_sapiens",
        "r_norvegicus"
    ),
    input_id = "Symbol",
    output_ids = "Ensembl_id",
    map_species = c(
        "h_sapiens",
        "r_norvegicus"
    ),
    map_tissues = c(
        "adult mammalian kidney",
        "heart"
    ),
    mapping_tool = "annotationDBI",
    ortholog_database = "HomoloGene",
    metric_type = "CV_Species"
)

CoSIAn_Obj_convert <- CoSIA::getConversion(CoSIAn_Obj)

head(CoSIA::viewCoSIAn(CoSIAn_Obj_convert, "converted_id"))

CoSIAn_Obj_gex <- CoSIA::getGEx(CoSIAn_Obj_convert)

head(CoSIA::viewCoSIAn(CoSIAn_Obj_gex, "gex"), 5)

CoSIAn_Obj_gexplot <- CoSIA::plotSpeciesGEx(CoSIAn_Obj_gex, "adult mammalian kidney", "ENSG00000136463")

CoSIAn_Obj_gexplot

CoSIAn_Obj_CV <- CoSIA::getGExMetrics(CoSIAn_Obj_convert)

CoSIAn_Obj_CVplot <- CoSIA::plotCVGEx(CoSIAn_Obj_CV)

CoSIAn_Obj_CVplot

workflows.name: cross_species_diversity_and_specificity
workflows.intent: Calculate and visualize Shannon entropy-based diversity and specificity (DS) across tissues or genes.
input: gene_set (character vector of gene symbols or IDs)
map_tissues (character vector of shared tissues, e.g., from getTissues())
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize the CoSIAn object with the gene set, species, tissues, and DS metric type ;; 2. Convert gene identifiers using getConversion ;; 3. Calculate DS metrics using getGExMetrics ;; 4. Plot DS metrics using plotDSGEx
workflows.code:
CoSIAn_Obj_DS <- CoSIA::CoSIAn(
    gene_set = unique(monogenic_kid_sample$Gene),
    i_species = "h_sapiens",
    o_species = c("h_sapiens", "r_norvegicus"),
    input_id = "Symbol",
    output_ids = "Ensembl_id",
    map_species = c("h_sapiens", "r_norvegicus"),
    map_tissues = c("adult mammalian kidney", "heart"),
    mapping_tool = "annotationDBI",
    ortholog_database = "HomoloGene",
    metric_type = "DS_Tissue"
)

CoSIAn_Obj_DS <- CoSIA::getConversion(CoSIAn_Obj_DS)

CoSIAn_Obj_DS <- CoSIA::getGExMetrics(CoSIAn_Obj_DS)

CoSIAn_Obj_DSplot <- CoSIA::plotDSGEx(CoSIAn_Obj_DS)

CoSIAn_Obj_DSplot
